title: Mission:Deliver 'Em All
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Deliver

Quest Description: Now that the figurines are painted, deliver them to the Townston Lieutenant

Quest Reward: 5000 gold and 4 King's Coins.

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: None

Last Build Updated: 155

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Deliver the Whisker Figurines to the Townston Lieutenant in Townston.

Offer:

Please, I would like to keep the conversation to a minimum. Normal people drive me crazy, that is why I live here in Algernon. I don't mind the occasional Dungeon Runner coming along and visiting for a while, but I cannot stand regular folk. Dungeon Runners have to be a little bit crazy and maybe that is why I get along with them so well. You, hahaha, you look crazier than most! I have a feeling that you are destined for glory. That, and a lot of resurrecting. Just be glad for technology. It was not that long ago that, when you died, you would have to walk all the way back to the cemetary, walk all the way back to your corpse, and then walk/drag your corpse all the way back to the last place you took a power nap, then eat three pieces of toast and do the funky chicken before you could get all of your items back. Much easier now, would you not agree?

Ok, here are the figurines. Tell the Commander I said 'hi' and that there should be some new Orok figurines coming some time soon. See you around, Dungeon Runner.

Turn-in:

Do you have them? Is the paint dry? Well, as much as I despise you, I must admit you did a good job. Usually, I am the one that has to go and pick up the new dolls for the Commander, but I think I have found me a new gopher!

Now that we got that business taken care of.... Do you want to open the figurines up and play around with them for a moment? I get to be Sissirat! And I have a force field so you can't hit me. And I can dodge all of your lasers and missiles. And I can never die. No, you didn't hit me, because I moved and my force field blocked your attack and I just killed your guy....

Tell anyone about this and you will never work in my Townston again. Or any Townston, for that matter. I am a powerful man. Powerful and...lonely.

Objectives:

  • Sissirat Clan Figurine Set (Painted) ×1

Client level range: 10–20
